# Introduction

This project analyzes gene expression differences between Alzheimer's disease patients and healthy controls using the GSE5281_EC dataset.

# Data Loading and Analysis

```{r analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("code/alzheimers_analysis.R")
```

# Results

The analysis compares 9 Alzheimer's disease samples and 12 control samples using 54,675 microarray probes.




## Expression Boxplot

```{r show-boxplot, echo=FALSE, out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(
  normalizePath("figures/01_Expression_Boxplot.png")
)
```

# Conclusion

The analysis identified 11,624 statistically significant probes using the Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value threshold of 0.05.
